Team,

Quick summary from the final loop for Aditya Sharma (Senior Inference Engineer / IC4 intent): strong system-design and runtime optimization experience, 3 live open-source projects we referenced, expects 3–4 weeks notice. Interview notes attached (AdityaSharma_InterviewNotes.pdf).

Proposed compensation (internal ask from recruiting): base $220k, equity 0.6% (4-year), sign-on $20k. That sits above the published IC4 midpoint for Bay Area — we're asking for a flexible-band approval to place him at the top of the band due to immediate impact on runtime workstreams.

Requesting:
- Level confirmation (IC4 vs IC5)
- Approve comp placement at $220k base with $20k sign-on (equity as above)
- Any objections or additional conditions (start date, relocation assistance) before I draft the offer letter.

Thanks for the summary. Two quick asks before I sign off:

Adding comp context: attached is the Comp_Workbook_ASH-8721.xlsx — I pulled market medians from our recent sourcing comp study (Dec 2026) and third-party data. Short takeaway:
- IC4 band (Bay Area): $150k–$200k base (midpoint $175k)
- Comparable candidates with his depth of production inference experience are being hired at $210k–$230k in similar companies

Recommendation: Approve one-time flexible-band exception to place him at $220k base (top quartile for IC4, below typical IC5). Sign-on of $20k to offset notice and counter risk. Equity at 0.6% is slightly above our median for IC4 — propose 4-year vesting with 12-month cliff and prorated first-year.

I can route the exception through Finance for budget sign-off; tagging Ben for a quick yes/no on headcount/budget.

Marissa — please proceed to get Finance sign-off on the one-time exception. Rachel, once Ben signs off, please prepare the offer letter draft and DocuSign package; include the $20k sign-on paid at first payroll.
